HF runner commit 92ec41cb26d233a388b6f65fa1a4b7c45d7ad8c5 and five completed fold jobs reproduce the frozen outputs.

reason: Clean-room bifolium-heldout replay reproduces strong second-order context but third-order gain changes sign or falls below ratio 2 under the frozen alpha grid in every transcription layer. Example ZLZI alpha=16: LTR effect -0.00098664/null SD 0.00247465; RTL +0.00371542/0.00255975 = 1.45.

All 64 candidate claims are recertified from explicit obligations; legacy labels are inputs only and cannot satisfy dependency closure.
